title: Tournai 1498 original printing: identity, complete offered images and bounded division review

uses.disposition: Add one earlier identified printed witness. Existing 1509,1527 and 1540 catalogue leads remain unacquired originals. A printing count is not a recension count.
uses.source_scope: Ghent University Library BHSL.RES.1379, Google BooksHldPAAAAcAAJ; all 580 unique offered images acquired and retained. Physical gathering completeness and complete text remain unestablished.

searches.bound: Search rendering and named exact public metadata responses, not a complete holding-library census.
searches.finding: USUARIUM 117 linked Google BooksHldPAAAAcAAJ as the Ghent 1498 witness. Original title and colophon were then inspected directly. BnF/BP 16 and USTC hits for later books remain catalogue discovery leads; no original of those later printings was inspected. The current Ghent search URL returned an application shell, not source catalogue evidence.

searches.bound: Ordinary public download and viewer routes; no accounts, credentials or gated access.
searches.finding: Offered Google PDF returned HTTP 429 on ordinary routes; USUARIUM PDF returned HTTP 401. Public click 3/image deliveries supplied all 580 unique offered page IDs. Initial unsigned content URLs returned a generic unavailable-image response and were not treated as book pages. No full provider-PDF bytes were acquired.

versions.classification: identified printing witness, not an established substantive recension
versions.scope: Latin original service-book witness. Title and incipit declare Tournai use; actual receipt by any particular church is unestablished. No normative act or textual parent is asserted.

versions.classification: existing catalogue witness lead; original not acquired in this lane
